sentence: This project builds language technologies that predict helping skills from text and suggest tailored assistance for people who support others in online peer support groups.
This project studies how unusually energetic electrons heat warm dense matter, a poorly understood plasma state, using ultrashort X-ray pulses.
This project builds deep learning models that use knowledge of physics to predict shear failure from ultrasonic data in laboratory experiments on rocks.
This project builds a wearable ultrasound system that takes 3D images of the breast without gel to help find breast cancer early.
This project builds AI methods that let a wireless network use camera and lidar data to predict what its users will need.
This project studies semiconductor materials and technologies, from optical nanomaterials to device fabrication and recyclability.
This project compares immune genes and antibodies across many mammalian species to find out why species differ in how they respond to infection.
This project builds machine learning models that explain their predictions to work out the rules behind RNA splicing and translation initiation.
This project studies sediment cores from a drilling program to learn how Earth's oceans and living things responded to a massive release of carbon long ago.
This project studies the structure of a protein in the mitochondria of a unicellular organism to understand how it does two different jobs.
This project studies how broken chromosomes caused by RNA-DNA hybrids get capped with telomere sequences instead of being repaired in Caenorhabditis elegans.
This project builds mathematical methods to monitor a factory with many stages by linking product quality with the health of each machine.
This project supports a conference that brings together researchers to explore ideas and results in computer and communications security.
This project runs two labs that use accelerator mass spectrometry to measure rare materials made when cosmic rays interact with rocks, soil and the atmosphere.
This project studies how the chemical structure of molecules that anchor targeting molecules to nanoparticles controls whether they detach in the body.
This project studies the history and genes behind bright plumage colors in tanagers to understand how bird species form and live together.
This project builds mathematical theory to explain why very large deep neural networks make accurate predictions and when they fail.
